fields.bio: Ana runs the house day to day: the room bookings, the rota and the kettle. Find her at the desk by the door most mornings.
Femi looks after the sixty-odd volunteers who keep the groups going, and finds a job for anyone who asks.
Margaret has chaired the committee since 2019 and has lived on Larch Street for forty years.
David keeps the accounts, chases the grants and presents the numbers at the AGM every November.
Priya leads the Thursday garden crew and the spring seed swap.
Owen leads the Larch Street Singers. No auditions, and no need to read music.
Rosa cooks Friday supper for forty with whoever turns up to help chop.
Sam runs Homework club in term time and the summer holiday days.

entries.title: The hall floor is being sanded

fields.standfirst: The main hall closes on Monday 30 November for two days while the floor is sanded and sealed.
fields.body:
Groups that meet in the main hall that week move to the small room or the garden. Little Feet and Chair yoga take the week off.

The floor was last done in 2009. Thank you to everyone who gave to the floor fund.
fields.image_alt: The hall floor is being sanded

fields.standfirst: The AGM, the winter fair and a new Saturday walk.
fields.body:
This month the AGM is on Tuesday 24 November, and the winter fair is on Saturday 12 December.

The Parkside walk now meets every Saturday at half past eight at the park gates.

fields.standfirst: Sixty-two neighbours gave 4,300 hours to the house this year.
fields.body:
From the Friday supper rota to the garden crew, the house runs on volunteers.

Come to the open day on 21 November to find out how to join them.

fields.standfirst: The harvest supper, half term and the Repair Table.
fields.body:
The harvest supper is on Saturday 3 October.

Homework club takes a break over half term and returns on 2 November.

fields.standfirst: Back to school, and the groups back after summer.
fields.body:
Every group is back from the first week of September.

We are looking for two volunteers for the Lunch Club kitchen.

fields.standfirst: Photos from the street party and the summer concert.
fields.body:
Thank you to everyone who came to the street party.

The house is open as usual through August.

seo.description: A community house on Larch Street, Elmbridge: groups, meals and classes most days of the week, run by neighbours.

/privacy.title: Privacy
/privacy.content:
Larch Street Community House keeps the details you send through our forms to reply to you, and the newsletter list to send the newsletter. We never sell or share them.

What we keep

Your name, your email and what you wrote. Newsletter addresses stay until you unsubscribe.

Asking us

Write to hello@larchstreet.example to see or delete what we hold about you.

/cookies.title: Cookies
/cookies.content: The site sets one cookie to remember that you closed the cookie notice, and nothing else. There is no tracking and no advertising.
